blind.description: A decorative brazier consisting of a carved light-grey stone pillar base with arched reliefs, supporting a wide golden-bronze bowl adorned with spherical studs around the outer rim. Inside, the bowl has a greenish-teal interior patina and is filled with fine grey ash and chunks of black charcoal. Surfaces are solid, smooth, and fully modeled with no floating or broken elements.
blind.from_above: Concentric circles featuring an outer golden rim bordered by studs, enclosing a circular pit of textured grey ash interspersed with dark charcoal fragments.
blind.height_vs_figure: About half the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (roughly 2.5 to 3 feet tall), with a bowl diameter of about 2.5 feet.

notes: proportions slightly more squat than catalog ratio, but matches requested short pedestal design
